style-board.prompt: A labeled VFX STYLE BOARD on a clean light background, laid out as a grid of effect swatches, with Monkey small in one corner for scale: (1) lobed smoke/dust puff in 4 dissipating stages, (2) spiky impact burst + 'POW' shape, (3) chunky 3D extruded 'Z' letters small/medium/large, (4) cyan sweat drops with white highlight, (5) bold yellow '!' with spiky white burst and a purple '?', (6) lightbulb with ray dashes, (7) gold 4-point twinkle sparkles, (8) pink hearts and gold stars, (9) concentric shockwave rings, (10) jagged ground crack with rounded rock chunks, (11) mini banana confetti with paper bits, (12) music notes. Include a palette strip with hex labels and a small outline-thickness guide. Title: 'MONKEY VFX STYLE'.

sleep.prompt: A 4-panel horizontal storyboard of Monkey falling asleep after being idle a long time, each panel labeled with timing: 1 'YAWN 0.0-1.2s' (huge yawn, arms stretching up, a pale yawn puff), 2 'SIT 1.2-2.4s' (plops down sitting, small dust puffs), 3 'LIE DOWN 2.4-3.6s' (lies on his back on jungle grass, belly up, one arm behind his head, headset still on, mic LED dimmed), 4 'SLEEP LOOP' (snoring, chest rising, a cartoon snot bubble, and three chunky 3D extruded cream 'Z' letters with dark outlines floating up in a sine wave, growing as they rise). Comedic and cozy.

wake.prompt: A 3-panel storyboard of Monkey WAKING UP when the user says 'Hey Monkey', labeled with timing: 1 'STARTLE 0.0-0.15s' (he jolts up mid-air from lying down, eyes wide, a bold yellow '!' with spiky white burst above his head, 3 radial shock lines, the floating Z letters popping like bubbles), 2 'LAND 0.15-0.5s' (lands on his feet in a squash pose with tan dust puffs ring), 3 'READY 0.5-1.0s' (sheepish grin, scratches his head, headset mic LED glowing bright cyan). Squash and stretch, comedic timing.

chest-beat.prompt: A 3-keyframe VFX callout of Monkey doing a proud chest beat: anticipation (arms drawn back, chest puffed), impact (fists on chest, squash pose) with two concentric white-yellow shockwave rings expanding from his chest and small impact stars, follow-through (rings at max size thinning, a tiny dust ring at his feet, a cocky grin). Label each frame with timing at 12 fps and the ring scale (0.3x -> 2.5x).

ground-slam.prompt: A 3-keyframe VFX callout of Monkey doing a comedic two-fisted GROUND SLAM on jungle dirt: windup (jumps up, fists together overhead, speed lines), impact frame (fists hit the ground, big spiky white impact flash, jagged dark star-shaped crack decal, a ring of lobed tan dust puffs, 8 chunky rounded rock and dirt chunks flying in arcs), aftermath (dust settling, chunks bounced, a few leaves falling, Monkey grinning). Label timings.

celebrate.prompt: Monkey celebrating a finished assignment: arms up in victory, a cone burst of mini banana confetti plus yellow/green/orange paper bits, gold 4-point twinkle sparkles around him, a few pink hearts, a big glowing green checkmark badge popping in beside him with a white ring. Include small callouts: 'confetti 2.5s cone up then flutter', 'sparkles staggered 0.25s each', 'check pop overshoot 1.4x'.

thinking.prompt: A sheet of Monkey's THINKING effects in 3 poses: (1) thinking hard, hand on chin, 2 cyan teardrop sweat drops popping from his temple, (2) puzzled, scratching head with a wobbly purple '?' above, (3) getting an idea, finger up, yellow lightbulb with flashing ray dashes popping above his head. Label each with timing and the attach point (temple, head-top).

emotions.prompt: A sheet of Monkey's EMOTION effects in 4 poses: (1) ANGRY with lobed white steam puffs bursting from his ears and a throbbing red cross-popping vein mark on his forehead, (2) LAUGHING hard with cyan tear droplets squirting sideways from his eyes, (3) DIZZY with 3 small gold stars orbiting his head and a spiral, (4) HAPPY with pink hearts and gold stars rising. Label each with duration and loop/one-shot.
